collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager's parent disapproves of their sweetheart: keep courting openly, or try to win the parent over.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is courting (friend), and (subject)'s parent, (third), does not approve. (third) says (friend) is lazy, which is not true, and too loud, which is a bit true. (subject) is a grown adult and does not need permission. But (subject.he/she) loves (third) and wants peace. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) tells (third) that (subject.he/she) loves (friend) and will go on courting (friend.him/her), with or without approval. (third) is hurt and says so. For a season, family dinners are very quiet. Then (friend) fixes (third)'s roof without being asked, and (third) is a little less sure.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) brings (friend) to dinner every week. (friend) is loud. (third) is stiff. But (friend) asks (third) about the old fishing songs, and (third) cannot resist telling (friend.him/her) all of them. By the end of the season, (third) says (friend) is too loud, fondly.
